title: Benabena language - Wikipedia
text: Benabena (Bena) is a Papuan language spoken in the Goroka District of Eastern Highlands Province, Papua New Guinea. Vowel sounds /i, e, a, o, u/ can also be heard as [ɪ, ɛ, ʌ, ɔ, ʊ] in word-initial or word-medial positions.

title: Benabena language — Grokipedia
text: The Benabena language, also known as Bena Bena, is spoken primarily in the Goroka District of the Eastern Highlands Province, Papua New Guinea, within a valley area that extends eastward from Goroka town and borders the Upper Ramu region of Madang Province.
